counting_policy: one event candidate per canonical source segment and date; translations do not add events

evidence.en:
- ------

     3/13/69 - 7:40 PM - Jane Garavello, a witness, reported seeing a strange object in the sky.
       In addition to other lights, she observed a cylindrical object with two lights at its ends.
       She stated that it flew over a football field at a low altitude. We later verified this with
       the owner of the property, whose son had also seen the object.
       No other observations were made at that time; the object could not be located on the grass
       due to the darkness
